title: Structured prerequisite replay no longer preserves promoted lineage into reserved preflight
symptom: Full harness fails on workflow, config, pricing, and blob-token structured preflight tests because reserved fresh-lineage preflight reuses placeholder values, duplicates init prereqs, and drops materialization_missing_families tracing.
trust_impact: A live reduced Batch B frontier run would depend on the same s02 prerequisite replay and fresh-lineage preflight seams, so package-scale floor-to-ceiling evidence would not be trustworthy.
allowed_next_actions: Inspect _current_lineage_hints promotion flow for fresh-lineage consumers
Restore the structured preflight trace fields required by blob-token materialization tests
Rerun only the failing structured_argument_scaffolder tests before any live campaign run
disallowed_next_actions: Launch a reduced or full Batch B live campaign
Treat the new planner artifact as sufficient proof that package mode is safe
Spend package-scale runtime budget before the structured preflight seam is green
exit_criteria: The currently failing structured_argument_scaffolder tests pass
python scripts/harness.py test -- tests/ -v --tb=short --ignore=tests/test_mcp_stdio.py passes again
